instruction: Put my things where they belong.

attempts.code:
go_home()
obs = observe()
red_block = obs["objects"]["red_block"]
purple_box = obs["zones"]["purple_box"]

# Check if purple_box is occupied
if purple_box["occupants"]:
    # Move the occupying object to orange_tray
    occupant = purple_box["occupants"][0]
    spots = free_spots("orange_tray", occupant)["spots"]
    if spots:
        spot = spots[0]
        carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["gripper_yaw"])
        lower_until_contact()
        open_gripper()
        retreat()
        check(occupant, "orange_tray")

# Get grasp candidates for red_block
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_block")
candidate = candidates[0]  # Use first candidate

# Grasp red_block
grasp_result = grasp(candidate)
if not grasp_result["holding_something"]:
    # Retry with adjusted height
    candidate["height"] += 0.01
    grasp_result = grasp(candidate)

# Find free spot in purple_box
spots = free_spots("purple_box", "red_block")["spots"]
if not spots:
    # No spot available; clear purple_box first
    occupant = purple_box["occupants"][0]
    spots = free_spots("orange_tray", occupant)["spots"]
    if spots:
        spot = spots[0]
        carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["gripper_yaw"])
        lower_until_contact()
        open_gripper()
        retreat()
        check(occupant, "orange_tray")
    spots = free_spots("purple_box", "red_block")["spots"]

# Carry red_block to purple_box
spot = spots[0]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["gripper_yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("red_block", "purple_box")
